verdict.rationale: Call-analytics dashboards are a fair axis for a voice-agent platform with a cloud offering, but no evidence in the pack documents built-in dashboards for success rates, durations, outcomes or sentiment. The only on-topic item is a community report of having no visibility into per-call latency or cost, which points to a gap rather than a shipped dashboard. The testing and simulation features cover pre-deployment evaluation, not production call analytics.
